'''First Justice''' was a position within the judiciaries of both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="CD" /> and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="CTD" />

In the Galactic Republic, the First Justice was the second in command of the twelve justices in the [[Supreme Court/Legends|Supreme Court]]. As such, the First Justice was in charge of all the things the [[Chief Justice]] left behind. The First Justice also was in charge of all other justices and the other Courts.<ref name="CD" />

Under the New Republic, the First Justice was a member of the [[Court of Justice]], and was elected by the body from among their number.<ref name="CTD" />
